pli-tv-kd4:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd4:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:1.1.3: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:1.1.4: kena nu kho mayaṃ upāyena samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vaseyyāma na ca piṇḍakena kilameyyāmā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd4:1.2.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:1.2.2: sace kho mayaṃ aññamaññaṃ n' eva ālapeyyāma na sallapeyyāma,
pli-tv-kd4:1.2.3: yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkameyya, so āsanaṃ paññāpeyya, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipeyya, avakkārapātiṃ dhovitvā upaṭṭhāpeyya, pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyya, ||2||
pli-tv-kd4:1.3.1: yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkameyya, sac' assa bhuttāvaseso, sace ākaṅkheyya, bhuñjeyya, no ce ākaṅkheyya, appaharite vā chaḍḍeyya appāṇake vā udake opilāpeyya,
pli-tv-kd4:1.3.2: so āsanaṃ uddhareyya, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmeyya, avakkārapātiṃ dhovitvā paṭisāmeyya, pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ paṭisāmeyya, bhattaggaṃ sammajjeyya, ||3||
pli-tv-kd4:1.4.1: yo passeyya pāniyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojaniyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ, so upaṭṭhāpeyya,
pli-tv-kd4:1.4.2: sac' assa avisayhaṃ hatthavikārena, dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpeyya,
pli-tv-kd4:1.4.3: na tv eva tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindeyya,
pli-tv-kd4:1.4.4: evaṃ kho mayaṃ samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vaseyyāma na ca piṇḍakena kilameyyāmā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd4:1.5.1: atha kho te bhikkhū aññamaññaṃ n' eva ālapiṃsu na sallapiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:1.5.2: yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, so āsanaṃ paññāpeti, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipati, avakkārapātiṃ dhovitvā upaṭṭhāpeti, pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd4:1.6.1: yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, sace hoti bhuttāvaseso, sace ākaṅkhati, bhuñjati, no ce ākaṅkhati, appaharite vā chaḍḍeti appāṇake vā udake opilāpeti,
pli-tv-kd4:1.6.2: so āsanaṃ uddharati pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmeti, avakkārapātiṃ dhovitvā paṭisāmeti, pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ paṭisāmeti, bhattaggaṃ sammajjati. ||6||
pli-tv-kd4:1.7.1: yo passati pāniyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojaniyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ, so upaṭṭhāpeti.
pli-tv-kd4:1.7.2: sac' assa hoti avisayhaṃ hatthavikārena, dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpeti, na tv eva tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindati. ||7||
pli-tv-kd4:1.8.1: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vassaṃ vutthānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:1.8.2: atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sāvatthī tena pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:1.8.3: anupubbena yena Sāvatthī Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo, yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:1.8.4: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ. ||8||
pli-tv-kd4:1.9.1: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd4:1.9.3: kacci samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasittha na ca piṇḍakena kilamitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:1.9.5: samaggā ca mayaṃ bhante sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasimhā na ca piṇḍakena kilamimhā 'ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd4:1.10.1: jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti, jānantāpi na pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd4:1.10.2: kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti, kalaṃ viditvā na pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd4:1.10.5: dvīhi ākārehi buddhā bhagavanto bhikkhū paṭipucchanti, dhammaṃ vā desessāma, sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:1.10.6: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca: yathākathaṃ pana tumhe bhikkhave samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasittha na ca piṇḍakena kilamitthā 'ti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.1: idha mayaṃ bhante sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upagacchimhā.
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.2: tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.3: kena nu kho mayaṃ upāyena samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vaseyyāma na ca piṇḍakena kilameyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.4: tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.12: evaṃ kho mayaṃ samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vaseyyāma na ca piṇḍakena kilameyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.13: atha kho mayaṃ bhante aññamaññaṃ n' eva ālapimhā na sallapimhā.
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.14: yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, so āsanaṃ paññāpeti, pādodakaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd4:1.11.18: evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasimhā na ca piṇḍakena kilamimhā 'ti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd4:1.12.2: aphāsuñ ñeva kira 'me bhikkhave moghapurisā vutthā samānā phāsu ' mha vutthā 'ti paṭijānanti,
pli-tv-kd4:1.12.3: pasusaṃvāsañ ñeva kira 'me bhikkhave moghapurisā vutthā samānā phāsu 'mha vutthā 'ti paṭijānanti,
pli-tv-kd4:1.12.4: eḷakasaṃvāsañ ñeva kira 'me bhikkhave moghapurisā vutthā samānā phāsu ' mha vutthā 'ti paṭijānanti,
pli-tv-kd4:1.12.5: pamattasaṃvāsañ ñeva kira 'me bhikkhave moghapurisā vutthā samānā phāsu 'mha vutthā 'ti paṭijānanti.
pli-tv-kd4:1.12.6: kathaṃ hi nām' ime bhikkhave moghapurisā mūgabbataṃ titthiyasamādānaṃ samādiyissanti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd4:1.13.1: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd4:1.13.2: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd4:1.13.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave vassaṃ vutthānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretuṃ
pli-tv-kd4:1.13.6: diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā.
pli-tv-kd4:1.13.7: sā vo bhavissati aññamaññānulomatā āpattivuṭṭhānatā vinayapurekkhāratā. ||13||
pli-tv-kd4:1.14.6: therena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:1.14.7: saṃghaṃ āvuso pavāremi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā,
pli-tv-kd4:1.14.10: dutiyam pi . . . tatiyam pi āvuso saṃghaṃ
pli-tv-kd4:1.14.13: pavāremi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā,
pli-tv-kd4:1.14.16: navakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū theresu bhikkhūsu ukkuṭikaṃ nisinnesu pavārayamānesu āsanesu acchanti.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū theresu bhikkhūsu ukkuṭikaṃ nisinnesu pavārayamānesu āsanesu acchissantīti.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū theresu . . . acchantīti.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.8: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā theresu . . . acchissanti.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.9: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.12: na bhikkhave theresu bhikkhūsu ukkuṭikaṃ nisinnesu pavārayamānesu āsanesu acchitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:2.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbeh' eva ukkuṭikaṃ nisinnehi pavāretun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd4:2.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro thero jarādubbalo yāva sabbe pavārentīti ukkuṭikaṃ nisinno āgamayamāno mucchito papati.
pli-tv-kd4:2.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave tadantarā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdituṃ yāva pavāreti, pavāretvā āsane nisīditun ti. ||2||2||
pli-tv-kd4:3.3.4: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd4:3.3.5: atthi bhante bhikkhu gilāno, so anāgato 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:3.3.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā pavāraṇaṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:3.3.8: tena gilānena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:3.3.9: pavāraṇaṃ dammi, pavāraṇaṃ me hara, mam' atthāya pavārehīti. kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, dinnā hoti pavāraṇā.
pli-tv-kd4:3.3.10: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na dinnā hoti pavāraṇā. ||3||
pli-tv-kd4:3.4.1: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:3.4.2: no ce labhetha, so bhikkhave gilāno bhikkhu mañcena vā pīṭhena vā saṃghamajjhe ānetvā pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:3.4.3: sace bhikkhave gilānupaṭṭhākānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd4:3.4.4: sace kho mayaṃ gilānaṃ ṭhānā cāvessāma, ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati kālaṃkiriyā vā bhavissatīti, na bhikkhave gilāno ṭhānā cāvetabbo,
pli-tv-kd4:3.4.6: na tv eva vaggena saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:3.5.1: pavāraṇāhārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pavāraṇāya . . . (= II.22.3,4. Read pavāraṇā,
pli-tv-kd4:3.5.77: anujānāmi bhikkhave tadahu pavāraṇāya pavāraṇaṃ dentena chandam pi dātuṃ santi saṃghassa karaṇīyan ti. ||5||3||
pli-tv-kd4:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ tadahu pavāraṇāya ñātakā gaṇhiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:4.1.3: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ tadahu pavāraṇāya ñātakā gaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd4:4.1.4: te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:4.1.5: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ muñcatha yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu pavāretīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.1: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.2: no ce labhetha, te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.3: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ ekamantaṃ hotha yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu pavāraṇaṃ detīti.
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.4: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.5: no ce labhetha, te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.6: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ nissīmaṃ netha yāva saṃgho pavāretīti.
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.7: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:4.2.8: no ce labhetha, na tv eva vaggena saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:4.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ tadahu pavāraṇāya rājāno gaṇhanti,
pli-tv-kd4:4.3.5: te bhikkhū paccatthikā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:4.3.14: na tv eva vaggena saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahu pavāraṇāya pañca bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.1.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:5.1.6: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi pavāretabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcannaṃ saṃghe pavāretun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd4:5.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahu pavāraṇāya cattāro bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.2.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:5.2.5: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi pavāretabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.3.2: vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd4:5.3.5: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ mayaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāreyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.3.6: therena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā te bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:5.3.7: ahaṃ āvuso āyasmante pavāremi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā,
pli-tv-kd4:5.3.14: navakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā te bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:5.3.15: ahaṃ bhante āyasmante pavāremi diṭṭhena vā . . .

pli-tv-kd4:5.4.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:5.4.3: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ pañcannaṃ saṃghe pavāretuṃ, catunnaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāretuṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:5.4.5: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi pavāretabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññata- rasmiṃ āvāse tadahu pavāraṇāya dve bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.5.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:5.5.3: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ pañcannaṃ saṃghe pavāretuṃ, catunnaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāretuṃ, tiṇṇannaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāretuṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:5.5.5: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi pavāretabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.6.2: therena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā navo bhikkhu evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:5.6.3: ahaṃ āvuso āyasmantaṃ pavāremi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā,
pli-tv-kd4:5.6.10: navakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ . . . paggahetvā thero bhikkhu evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:5.6.11: ahaṃ bhante āyasmantaṃ pavāremi diṭṭhena vā . . .
pli-tv-kd4:5.7.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahu pavāraṇāya eko bhikkhu viharati.
pli-tv-kd4:5.7.2: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:5.7.3: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ pañcannaṃ saṃghe pavāretuṃ, catunnaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāretuṃ, tiṇṇannaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāretuṃ, dvinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ pavāretuṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:5.7.5: kathaṃ nu kho mayā pavāretabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:5.8.1: idha pana bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahu pavāraṇāya eko bhikkhu viharati.
pli-tv-kd4:5.8.2: tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā yattha bhikkhū paṭikkamanti upaṭṭhānasālāya vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā, sa deso sammajjitvā pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā āsanaṃ paññāpetvā padīpaṃ katvā nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:5.8.3: sace aññe bhikkhū āgacchanti, tehi saddhiṃ pavāretabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:5.8.4: no ce āgacchanti, ajja me pavāraṇā 'ti adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:5.9.1: tatra bhikkhave yattha pañca bhikkhū viharanti, na ekassa pavāraṇaṃ āharitvā catūhi saṃghe pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:5.9.3: tatra bhikkhave yattha cattāro bhikkhū viharanti, na ekassa pavāraṇaṃ āharitvā tīhi aññamaññaṃ pavāretabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd4:16.12.2: cattāri ca pārājikāni terasa saṃghādisesā ayaṃ sīlavipatti,
pli-tv-kd4:16.12.3: thullaccayaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ayaṃ ācāravipatti,
pli-tv-kd4:16.12.4: micchādiṭṭhi antaggāhikā diṭṭhi ayaṃ diṭṭhivipattīti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:16.12.5: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapesi, diṭṭhena ṭhapesi, sutena ṭhapesi, parisaṅkāya ṭhapesīti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd4:16.13.2: diṭṭhena vā ṭhapemi, sutena vā ṭhapemi, parisaṅkāya vā ṭhapemīti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:16.13.3: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno diṭṭhena pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapesi, kiṃ te diṭṭhaṃ, kinti te diṭṭhaṃ, kadā te diṭṭhaṃ, kattha te diṭṭhaṃ, pārājikaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho, saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd4:16.13.8: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho, kattha ca tvaṃ ahosi, kattha cāyaṃ bhikkhu ahosi, kiṃ ca tvaṃ karosi, kiṃ cāyaṃ bhikkhu karotīti. ||13||
pli-tv-kd4:16.14.2: na kho ahaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno diṭṭhena pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapemi, api ca sutena pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapemīti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:16.14.3: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno sutena pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapesi, kiṃ te sutaṃ, kinti te sutaṃ, kadā te sutaṃ, kattha te sutaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:16.14.4: pārājikaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti sutaṃ, saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti sutaṃ, thullaccayaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti sutaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:16.14.5: bhikkhussa sutaṃ, bhikkhuniyā s., sikkhamānāya s., sāmaṇerassa s., sāmaṇeriyā s., upāsakassa s., upāsikāya s., rājūnaṃ s., rājamahāmattānaṃ s., titthiyānaṃ s., titthiyasāvakānaṃ sutan ti. ||14||
pli-tv-kd4:16.15.1: so ce evaṃ vadeyya: na kho ahaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno sutena pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapemi, api ca parisaṅkāya pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapemīti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:16.15.2: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno parisaṅkāya pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapesi, kiṃ parisaṅkasi, kinti parisaṅkasi, kadā parisaṅkasi, kattha parisaṅkasi,
pli-tv-kd4:16.15.3: pārājikaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti parisaṅkasi, saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti parisaṅkasi, thullaccayaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti parisaṅkasi,
pli-tv-kd4:16.15.4: bhikkhussa sutvā parisaṅkasi . . . titthiyasāvakānaṃ sutvā parisaṅkasīti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd4:16.16.2: na kho ahaṃ āvuso imassa bhikkhuno parisaṅkāya pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapemi, api ca ahaṃ na jānāmi kena ahaṃ imassa bhikkhuno pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapemīti,
pli-tv-kd4:16.16.3: so ce bhikkhave codako bhikkhu anuyogena viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ cittaṃ na ārādheti ananuvādo cudito bhikkhū 'ti alaṃ vacanāya.
pli-tv-kd4:16.16.4: so ce bhikkhave codako bhikkhu anuyogena viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ cittaṃ ārādheti sānuvādo cudito bhikkhū 'ti alaṃ vacanāya. ||16||
pli-tv-kd4:16.17.1: so ce bhikkhave codako bhikkhu amūlakena pārājikena anuddhaṃsitaṃ paṭijānāti, saṃghādisesaṃ ropetvā saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:16.17.2: so ce bhikkhave codako bhikkhu amūlakena saṃghādisesena anuddhaṃsitaṃ paṭijānāti, yathādhammaṃ kārāpetvā saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:16.17.3: so ce bhikkhave codako bhikkhu amūlakena thullaccayena
pli-tv-kd4:16.17.7: dubbhāsitena anuddhaṃsitaṃ paṭijānāti, yathādhammaṃ kārāpetvā saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ. ||17||
pli-tv-kd4:16.18.1: so ce bhikkhave cudito bhikkhu pārājikaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti paṭijānāti, nāsetvā saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:16.18.2: so ce bhikkhave cudito bhikkhu saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti paṭijānāti, saṃghādisesaṃ ropetvā saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd4:16.18.3: so ce bhikkhave cudito bhikkhu thullaccayaṃ
pli-tv-kd4:16.18.7: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti paṭijānāti, yathādhammaṃ kārāpetvā saṃghena pavāretabbaṃ. ||18||
pli-tv-kd4:16.19.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu tadahu pavāraṇāya thullaccayaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.19.2: ekacce bhikkhū thullaccayadiṭṭhino honti, ekacce bhikkhū saṃghādisesadiṭṭhino honti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.19.3: ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū thullaccayadiṭṭhino, tehi so bhikkhave bhikkhu ekamantaṃ apanetvā yathādhammaṃ kārāpetvā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:16.19.4: yaṃ kho so āvuso bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpanno, sāssa yathādhammaṃ paṭikatā.
pli-tv-kd4:16.20.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu tadahu pavāraṇāya thullaccayaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.20.2: ekacce bhikkhū thullaccayadiṭṭhino honti, ekacce bhikkhū pācittiyadiṭṭhino honti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.20.3: ekacce bhikkhū thullaccayadiṭṭhino honti, ekacce bhikkhū pāṭidesanīyadiṭṭhino honti.

pli-tv-kd4:16.21.5: ekacce bhikkhū dubbhāsitadiṭṭhino honti, ekacce bhikkhū saṃghādisesadiṭṭhino honti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.21.6: ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū dubbhāsitadiṭṭhino, tehi . . . (= 19) . . .

pli-tv-kd4:16.23.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu tadahu pavāraṇāya saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd4:16.23.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, vatthuṃ ṭhapetvā saṃgho pavāreyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.23.6: bhagavatā kho āvuso visuddhānaṃ pavāraṇā paññattā.
pli-tv-kd4:16.23.7: sace vatthuṃ paññāyati na puggalo, idān' eva naṃ vadehīti. ||23||
pli-tv-kd4:16.24.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu tadahu pavāraṇāya saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd4:16.24.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, puggalaṃ ṭhapetvā saṃgho pavāreyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:16.24.6: bhagavatā kho āvuso samaggānaṃ pavāraṇā paññattā.
pli-tv-kd4:16.24.7: sace puggalo paññāyati na vatthuṃ, idān' eva naṃ vadehīti. ||24||
pli-tv-kd4:16.25.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu tadahu pavāraṇāya saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd4:16.25.3: idaṃ vatthuñ ca puggalo ca paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd4:16.25.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, vatthuñ ca puggalañ ca ṭhapetvā saṃgho pavāreyyā 'ti.

pli-tv-kd4:16.26.2: pubbe ce bhikkhave pavāraṇāya puggalo paññāyati, pacchā vatthuṃ, kallaṃ vacanāya.
pli-tv-kd4:16.26.3: pubbe ce bhikkhave pavāraṇāya vatthuñ ca puggalo ca paññāyati, taṃ ce katāya pavāraṇāya ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||26||16||
pli-tv-kd4:17.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:17.1.2: tesaṃ sāmantā aññe bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā kalahakārakā vivādakārakā bhassakārakā saṃghe adhikaraṇakārakā vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd4:17.1.3: mayaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vassaṃ vutthānaṃ pavāraṇāya pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:17.1.5: amhākaṃ kira sāmantā aññe bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā vassaṃ upagatā
pli-tv-kd4:17.1.7: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:17.2.1: idha pana bhikkhave sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd4:17.2.2: tesaṃ sāmantā aññe bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā vassaṃ upagacchanti
pli-tv-kd4:17.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave tehi bhikkhūhi dve tayo uposathe cātuddasike kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd4:17.2.5: kathaṃ mayaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi paṭhamataraṃ pavāreyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:17.2.6: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā āvāsaṃ āgacchanti, tehi bhikkhave āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi lahuṃ-lahuṃ sannipatitvā pavāretabbaṃ, pavāretvā vattabbā:
pli-tv-kd4:17.3.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā asaṃvihitā taṃ āvāsaṃ āgacchanti, tehi bhikkhave āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, pāniyena pucchitabbā,
pli-tv-kd4:17.3.2: tesaṃ vikkhitvā nissīmaṃ gantvā pavāretabbaṃ, pavāretvā vattabbā:
pli-tv-kd4:17.4.1: evañ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:17.4.2: no ce labhetha, āvāsikena bhikkhunā vyattena paṭibalena āvāsikā bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd4:17.4.4: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, idāni uposathaṃ kareyyāma pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyyāma, āgame kāḷe pavāreyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd4:17.4.5: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
pli-tv-kd4:17.4.6: sādh' āvuso idān' eva no pavārethā 'ti, te evaṃ assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:17.4.7: anissarā kho tumhe āvuso amhākaṃ pavāraṇāya,
pli-tv-kd4:17.5.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā taṃ kāḷaṃ anuvaseyyuṃ, āvāsikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā vyattena paṭibalena āvāsikā bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd4:17.5.4: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
pli-tv-kd4:17.5.5: sādh' āvuso idān' eva no pavārethā 'ti, te evaṃ assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd4:17.5.6: anissarā kho tumhe āvuso amhākaṃ pavāraṇāya, na tāva mayaṃ pavāressāmā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd4:17.6.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā tam pi juṇhaṃ anuvaseyyuṃ, tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi sabbeh' eva āgame juṇhe komudiyā cātumāsiniyā akāmā pavāretabbaṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-kd4:17.7.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne gilāno agilānassa pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:17.7.6: evaṃ ce vuccamāno codeti, anādariye pācittiyaṃ. ||7||
pli-tv-kd4:17.8.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne agilāno gilānassa pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:17.8.4: āgamehi āvuso yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu ārogo hoti,
pli-tv-kd4:17.8.6: evaṃ ce vuccamāno codeti, anādariye pācittiyaṃ. ||8||
pli-tv-kd4:17.9.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne gilāno gilānassa pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:17.9.6: evaṃ ce vuccamāno codeti, anādariye pacittiyaṃ. ||9||
pli-tv-kd4:17.10.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne agilāno agilānassa pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, ubho saṃghena samanuyuñjitvā samanuggāhitvā yathādhammaṃ kārāpetvā saṃghena pavāretabban ti. ||10||17||
pli-tv-kd4:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd4:18.1.2: tesaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ viharataṃ aññataro phāsuvihāro adhigato hoti.
pli-tv-kd4:18.1.3: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd4:18.1.5: sace mayaṃ idāni pavāressāma, siyāpi bhikkhū pavāretvā cārikaṃ pakkameyyuṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:18.1.6: evaṃ mayaṃ imamhā phāsuvihārā paribāhirā bhavissāma.
pli-tv-kd4:18.1.7: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd4:18.2.1: idha pana bhikkhave sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd4:18.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave tehi bhikkhūhi pavāraṇāsaṃgahaṃ kātuṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd4:18.3.3: sannipatitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd4:18.3.5: amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ viharataṃ aññataro phāsuvihāro adhigato.
pli-tv-kd4:18.3.6: sace mayaṃ idāni pavāressāma, siyāpi bhikkhū pavāretvā cārikaṃ pakkameyyuṃ,
pli-tv-kd4:18.3.7: evaṃ mayaṃ imamhā phāsuvihārā paribāhirā bhavissāma.
pli-tv-kd4:18.3.8: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho pavāraṇāsaṃgahaṃ kareyya, idāni uposathaṃ kareyya pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya, āgame komudiyā cātumāsiniyā saṃgho pavāreyya.
pli-tv-kd4:18.4.5: saṃgho pavāraṇāsaṃgahaṃ karoti, idāni uposathaṃ karissati pātimokkhaṃ uddisissati, āgame komudiyā cātumāsiniyā pavāressati.
pli-tv-kd4:18.4.6: yassāyasmato khamati pavāraṇāsaṃgahassa karaṇaṃ idāni uposathaṃ karissati pātimokkhaṃ uddisissati, āgame komudiyā cātumāsiniyā pavāressati, so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd4:18.4.8: kato saṃghena pavāraṇāsaṃgaho idāni uposathaṃ karissati pātimokkhaṃ uddisissati, āgame komudiyā cātumāsiniyā pavāressati.
pli-tv-kd4:18.4.9: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd4:18.5.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi kate pavāraṇāsaṃgahe aññataro bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd4:18.5.3: atthi me janapade karaṇīyan ti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:18.5.5: so ce bhikkhave bhikkhu pavārayamāno aññatarassa bhikkhuno pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:18.5.6: anissaro kho me tvaṃ āvuso pavāraṇāya, na tāvāhaṃ pavāressāmīti.
pli-tv-kd4:18.5.7: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno pavārayamānassa aññataro bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, ubho saṃghena samanuyuñjitvā samanuggāhitvā yathādhammaṃ kārāpetabbā. ||5||
pli-tv-kd4:18.6.1: so ce bhikkhave bhikkhu janapade taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā punad eva anto komudiyā cātumāsiniyā taṃ āvāsaṃ āgacchati, tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne aññataro bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, so evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd4:18.6.2: anissaro kho me tvaṃ āvuso pavāraṇāya,
pli-tv-kd4:18.6.4: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne so bhikkhu aññatarassa bhikkhuno pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, ubho saṃghena samanuyuñjitvā samanuggāhitvā yathādhammaṃ kārāpetvā saṃghena pavāretabban ti. ||6||18|| pavāraṇakkhandhakaṃ catutthaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthu chacattārisā. tassa
